newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks start 0.54 pct up after new gvt.
newsitem.headline: French stocks start 0.54 pct up after new gvt.

text.p: French shares started 0.54 percent higher, despite falls on Wall Street and in London, the morning after Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin named his government including a Communist minister for transport.
Brokers said investors were awaiting the government's policy statement. The first cabinet meeting started at 0800 GMT.
Sanofi SOFP.PAL up 4.65 percent in early trade after Wednesday's profit forecast of a rise in 1997 earnings comparable to the rise in 1996.
* CAC-40 index up 16.92, or 0.64 percent, at 2,652.29 at 0804 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures 2,632 vs 2,614 at Wednesday's close.
